articles.title: Percy Jackson Season 3 Starts with a Monster Fight in a Parking Garage!
articles.summary: Disney+ showed the first minutes of Percy Jackson Season 3 at Comic-Con. It starts with Thalia fighting a monster in a parking garage, and Percy shows up to help—even though she doesn't want it. New faces like Nico di Angelo join the quest to save Annabeth and Artemis.

articles.title: Action Star Jason Statham Returns to His First Love: High Diving!
articles.summary: Before he was a movie tough guy, Jason Statham was a competitive diver for England. He showed up at a high diving event in Moscow, wearing a swimsuit and warming up with athletes. He even took pictures with fans, proving he still loves the sport he started as a kid.

articles.title: Roman Soldiers Found Buried in Wells? A Shocking Discovery in Slovakia!
articles.summary: Archaeologists found a huge Roman army camp in Slovakia with skeletons of soldiers buried in wells and ditches. The camp was used by Emperor Marcus Aurelius' troops during wars with Germanic tribes almost 1,900 years ago. Even their sandals with iron nails were preserved!
